text: In acute hippocampal slices from 3-month-old APOE-targeted-replacement mice, Reelin enhanced LTP in ApoE3 mice but not in ApoE4 mice (Reelin resistance), a synaptic consequence the authors attribute to the ApoE4-induced early-endosomal trafficking/acidification defect; Reelin responsiveness was restored by conditional NHE6 deletion in ApoE4 mice (reported: qualitative (Reelin significantly enhanced LTP at 21-40 and 41-60 min in ApoE3 but produced no significant enhancement at any interval in ApoE4)).
description: Hippocampal field recordings (Schaffer collateral-CA1, theta-burst stimulation, ± Reelin 2 µg/ml) in acute slices from 3-month-old male/female Slc9a6fl;ApoeAPOE3 and Slc9a6fl;ApoeAPOE4 knock-in mice (tamoxifen-injected Cre-negative controls). Caveat: mouse brain slices, not human astrocytes; readout is synaptic plasticity, several steps removed from endosomal pH.

provenance.excerpt: Reelin facilitated induction of LTP in ApoeAPOE3 (A, E), but not ApoeAPOE4 (C, G) control (Slc9a6fl) mice.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (loss of Reelin-enhanced LTP, i.e. Reelin resistance) -> [inferred early-endosomal recycling/pH defect]

warnings: effect size 'qualitative (Reelin significantly enhanced LTP at 21-40 and 41-60 min in ApoE3 but produced no significant enhancement at any interval in ApoE4)' has no accepted form: recorded as qualitative, numbers kept in description

perturbed.variable: APOE genotype of targeted-replacement mice: ApoeAPOE3 vs ApoeAPOE4 (homozygous human APOE knock-in), both Slc9a6fl Cre-negative controls

measured.variable: Reelin-induced enhancement of theta-burst LTP (normalized fEPSP slope) in hippocampal CA1 field recordings — downstream readout of ApoE receptor/glutamate receptor recycling
